title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2 — Education and Argumentation
prompt: Some people believe that secondary schools should require students to study philosophy and logic, arguing that these subjects sharpen reasoning and help young people evaluate competing claims. Others maintain that such subjects are too abstract for teenagers and that schools should instead devote that time to practical, career-oriented courses. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your essay, explain which position you find more convincing and why, using specific reasons and examples to support your argument. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有情景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读题目，确认题目要求你讨论双方观点并给出自己的立场。写作时请用清晰的段落结构展开论证：引言段表明话题与你的立场；主体段分别讨论支持哲学与逻辑课程的理由，以及支持实用职业课程的理由，并评估双方论据的强弱；随后用一段明确阐述你自己的观点并说明理由；结论段总结并重申立场。请确保每个主体段都有主题句、解释和具体例子，避免只罗列观点。全文不少于250词，建议用时40分钟，写完后检查论点是否始终围绕题目要求，而非偏离到其他教育话题。
